pattern: \b(content filter|blocked response|content (?:policy|safety) violation|refused (?:request|to respond)|response (?:was )?refused|safety filter|content blocked|moderation block)\b

^
    v?                                # tolerate leading v (Go)
    (?P<major>\d+)
    (?:\.(?P<minor>\d+))?
    (?:\.(?P<patch>\d+))?
    (?:-(?P<pre>[0-9A-Za-z.-]+))?     # pre-release
    (?:\+(?P<build>[0-9A-Za-z.-]+))?  # build metadata (ignored for ordering)
    $

(?://|[#]|/\*)       # comment opener
        \s*nosemgrep         # keyword
        (?::[ \t]*           # optional colon + rule list
          ([\w.:,/-]+)       # group 1: comma-separated rule IDs
        )?
        (?:[ \t]+(.+?))?     # group 2: justification text
        (?:\s*\*/)?          # optional block-comment closer
        \s*$

\b(?:env|printenv|set|export\s+-p)\b   # env-dumping commands
    [^\n|>]*                                # anything except pipe/newline/redirect
    >+(?!>)                                 # all consecutive > (no backtracking past last >)
    \s*
    (?:"|'|)                                # optional quote
    (?!\s*\$\{?GITHUB_(?:ENV|OUTPUT|PATH))  # NOT a GHA-target write

^\s*(?:el)?if\s+            # if or elif
    (\w+)                       # variable name
    \s*==\s*                    # ==
    (?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)')     # string literal (double or single quoted)
